requirement: All candidate parameters and semantics are hashed before PnL is visible.
Every frozen parameter affects an asserted execution path or is explicit non-economic metadata.
Dry-run and historical engines are semantically equivalent, or one canonical engine is reused.
Signals use completed information only and next-bar execution semantics are explicit.
Current-bar high/low ordering is never assumed for stop or trailing updates.
Signal label, expected move, cost comparison, and holding horizon are dimensionally aligned.
A pre-PnL funnel reports survival through every binary gate; economic quality prefers scoring over stacked filters.
Universe membership and asset identity are causal and survivorship-resistant.
Synthetic and dry-run routing cannot create negative cash.
Base and 2x execution cost assumptions are frozen before economic output.
Trade, asset, month, year, and leave-one-out contribution diagnostics are specified before PnL.
2024 remains closed until a finalist is frozen; 2025+ remains sealed.
